items.title: Larry Gold interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2025
items.q: My father used to call me "the Baron."

ctx.x: Yes it reminds me of some of the guys that played in the Depression. Eddie [Billy] Bauer talked about making, you know 40 bucks a week when his father was making 8.
That's right. My father used to call me "the Baron."
